## How to test

---

- [ ] Every commit signed off (`git commit -s`) — see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] `pnpm build`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm check:kernel` pass
- [ ] Docs updated in this PR
- [ ] ADR added, if this is a structural decision
- [ ] No version bump
